name: @answerdotai/mdhtml
description: mdhtml's Markdown parser for the browser, compiled to WebAssembly

scripts.build: rustup -q target add wasm32-unknown-unknown && cargo rustc --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --profile wasm -- -C link-arg=--compress-relocations && mkdir -p pkg && cp ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm/mdhtml_wasm.wasm pkg/
